$comment: Which scenes the adventure draws with Stagecraft: Puppet Show, and how. A key is a scene-set id (data/campaign/scene-set.json). 'description' is Stagecraft's own stage description (module/stagecraft/scripts/core/scene.mjs: everything positional is a fraction of the painting); the rest is the adventure's, keyed by each person's own id: where they stand when they arrive (places), the slots anyone else takes, the row the party stands in, what they do on their own (life: a Stagecraft routine), how they arrive (enter: walk on from left, right or the back, or rise out of the floor), a habit shown over their head now and then (emotes), a line of text under their name on the card (titles: { 'nobu': 'Quartermaster' }; it is laid out to fit, a line break in it is kept), the scene's authored blocking (moments: buttons on the GM's strip), and what a fired trigger does (onTrigger: summon people, play a moment). Read by foundry/stagecraft-bridge.mjs; a deploy that changes an entry changes the scene.

the-nest-wakes.label: The nest wakes
the-nest-wakes.tip: The fight board goes up for everyone: the walkways, the flood, the compactor and the panels, and who is in each.

break-for-the-grate.label: They break for the grate
break-for-the-grate.tip: Once half are down, the rest scurry back to the grate in the middle of the flood.

party-right-walkway.label: Party: right walkway
